June 19, 2009 Assalamualaikum Wo Rahmathullahi Barkathahu, My name is Mohammed Safiulla from Bangalore, India. Kindly let me know the Fatwa in light of Quran and Sunnah. My Father in law passed away last year. May Allah reward him with a place in Jannathul firdose. Amin. Summ Amin. My deceased Father in law has two sons-one married and the other a bachelor and one daughter who is also married. I would like to know how the property that used to be owned by my deceased father in law need to be distributed. My mother in law is alive and she is taking the family pension. Also let me know whether the children have any rights in the deceased?s pension also. Also my deceased father in law has got some ancestral property from his father. Kindly let me know whether the grand children (two grand sons and a grand daughter) have got any right in this property. Please note that there is no WILL on any of the properties by my deceased Father in law. Your earliest reply would be highly appreciated. 1676 views Q. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 50646 Country: India Title: inheritence Question: A woman dies leaving behind three sons and one daughter [3 sons & 1 daughter]. How her property shall be divided? A person dies leaving behind his wife, three sons and one daughter [1 wife, 3 sons, 1 daughter]. How shall his property be divided? Answer ID: 50646 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 435/B-88/TB=03/1435) In case the questions are true, all the property shall be divided into 7 shares after paying due rights proceeding inheritance. Out of the total each son shall get 2-2 shares and the daughter shall get 1 share. The division of the property is as follows: Details: Sons: 3x2=6 Daughter: 1x1=1 Total: 7 Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
